title: NPC & World Identity Registry
dek: Find every supplied discovery: people, companions, manifestations, collectives and encounters, with their evidence and documented prominence.
sources: Fenumion Recently Discovered NPCs · supplied 11 October 2026; raw census labels, not a distinct-person count
body:
These figures were present in Fenumion before their names reached the priority roster. Browse all 322 supplied labels here; aliases point to existing histories, while created entities, companions and generic encounters retain their distinctions.

Browse NPCs by island · Open the character directory

How prominence is rated

The editorial score weighs documented consequences (35%), institutional or witness role (25%), relationships (20%) and recorded presence (20%). Each rated entry explains its assessment and confidence. A high dialogue count does not establish high consequence. Where those impacts have not been established, prominence stays unrated and recorded presence is shown separately.

Recorded presence uses a logarithmic dialogue count worth up to 12 points and a posting span worth up to 8. It is a retrieval aid. Protected identities have no public names, scores, counts or source links.

evidence.label: Accounts & interpretation
evidence.summary: Read observations, attributed statements and interpretation with the qualifications preserved in this section. The listed references support the article as a whole; individual claims have not all received a separate evidence review.
